thread:
Harper Gomez: thinking about a new "Invoke Shelf" concept for the Playground: small, persistent rail on the right that shows search, pinned examples, and a collapsed schema flyout. goal: surface examples without stealing canvas. reactions?
Diego Morales: right-rail could work. recommend 200px min, collapsible to icons-only. on narrow screens it should become a bottom sheet.
Priya Sen: testers confused by 'Tools' label last time. propose header: 'Invoke Shelf' with microcopy 'Search examples, functions, schemas'. feels clearer for non-devs.
Evan Brooks: accessibility: when collapsed to icons-only, ensure each icon has aria-label and visible focus ring. for the sheet, trap focus and restore it to the shelf toggle.
Harper Gomez: layout nit: show pinned example snippets at top, then search, then the function list. examples acted as mental models in user tests.
Diego Morales: signature layout: monospaced function name + small param preview, wrap smartly. add quick actions inline: [+insert] [examples] [edit schema].
Priya Sen: schema flyout should be lazy-loaded to keep initial render fast. collapsed-by-default for quick tries. display a small orange badge for validation warnings and red for errors. badge tooltip links to first error line.
Evan Brooks: motion accessibility: respect prefers-reduced-motion. also add an aria-live polite announcement when a tool is inserted: 'Tool inserted: summarize_notes'.
Harper Gomez: run history change: show a tiny pill indicating 'tool used' with hover to reveal variant and quantization info for authorized users. default hides details for privacy.
Diego Morales: backend note: we'll add invocation fields: 'variant_hint' and 'usage_hint' — UI to show human label only if user has permission. will post a PR.
Priya Sen: keyboard shortcuts: Slash to focus shelf search, Arrow keys to navigate, Enter to insert, Shift+Enter to preview examples. make sure the shelf is reachable via keyboard only.
Evan Brooks: small copy tweak: 'Replay' -> 'Replay invocation' in run history to reduce ambiguity. also prefer 'Invocation details' in labels for screen readers.
ux-bot: Reminder: design review in 15m. Prototype link: https://www.figma.com/file/zzzz-invoke-shelf-proto . Add comments on keyboard flow. :spiral_calendar:
Harper Gomez: I'll update the figma with icons-only state and badge styles.
Diego Morales: I'll prep the trace schema changes and include privacy gating.
Priya Sen: I'll draft the a11y checklist and run quick VoiceOver smoke tests.
Evan Brooks: I'll wire up the aria-live messages and reduced-motion checks in the component library.
Harper Gomez: great. next steps: Harper figma, Diego backend PR, Priya a11y checklist, Evan implement. cc @Product for prioritization. thanks! :rocket:
